Transaction 3638829 was conducted online using device D000503, which was flagged as New for this account and operated behind an anonymous proxy.

Device D000503 has a generic profile, zero closed fraud cases all-time across the bank, is not part of any fraud ring (ring_id -1), and connects to only one other card in 90 days with no fraud flagged.

Card C08842-K2 history demonstrates extensive prior usage in region 299 (332 of 784 transactions), frequent purchases in product H (38 transactions), and established online channel use (91 transactions).
Shared origin analysis indicates that region 299 has a lift of 0.28 vs baseline and device D000503 has a lift of 0.0, confirming no anomalous concentration of fraud.
Transaction 3638829 was an isolated modest purchase of $43.92 with no preceding authorization run or card testing sequence (fits_card_testing_r5 is false).

Card C08842-K2 suffered confirmed fraud in July through October 2016 including CC-4809 and CC-4281, though the card was reissued, no fraud has occurred in over two months, and the prior model alert CC-0026 was cleared.

evidence.claim: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal. If the case rests on a single signal (including a risk score alone) and your assessed fraud probability is below 0.70, recommend `VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER` or `STEP_UP_AUTH` before any block. Blocking a legitimate customer on one signal is a policy breach.

case.summary: Alert HHF-017 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.55 on transaction 3638829 ($43.92) on card C08842-K2. Although the transaction originated from an anonymous proxy and a newly seen device, the calibrated second-generation fraud model scored it at 0.0, and the device has no ties to fraud rings or confirmed abuse. The activity was consistent with the cardholder's established billing region, product category, and online purchase patterns. Following cardholder verification confirming the purchase was authorized, the case was determined to be a false alarm and closed.
